project.title: Proteome of OGA stalk domain mutants
project.projectDescription: The proteomic analysis of cancer-derived, OGA stalk domain mutant S652F in T-REx HEK293 cells
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Cells were induced to express Flag-tagged OGA WT/stalk domain mutations. Proteins were digested, dimethyl labeled (OGA WT, L(light); R586A, M(median); S652F (H(heavy)), and analyzed byLC-MS/MS. Technical replicates and biological triplicates were applied for MS analysis.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw files were processed by MaxQuant. Imputation was applied to the data using Perseus for stastical evaulation.
